description: Current-model lint registry for terms that are not valid v1 core concept names. It is a prose/code hygiene aid, not a wire contract; conformance scanners may grep downstream prose and source for occurrences outside allowed_contexts.

rejection_levels.hard_reject: MUST NOT appear in current normative prose, current SDK / service code identifiers, or current UI copy describing v1 core model.
rejection_levels.docs_only: Forbidden in current model and normative surfaces; allowed only in the contexts explicitly listed by the term entry (currently changelog and negative_test).

allowed_context_definitions.interop_module: Reference in interop binding documentation (e.g., MIMI / Matrix interop).
allowed_context_definitions.negative_test: Reference in negative fixtures / cotest drift tests.

entries.notes: Use Arkret / arkret / `ak.` / `ak:` in all current prose, identifiers, file names, and UI copy; the listed term and prefixes are forbidden current-wire inputs.

Use 'External Collaboration Realm' (the role defined in zh/models/realm-and-space.md §2.7). The sovereign-deployment policy bundle that historically motivated the 'Controlled' prefix is now expressed as 'in sovereign deployment, External Collaboration Realm MUST satisfy …' and lives in zh/sync/sovereign-deployment.md §4 under ak.profile.sovereign_deployment.v1; it is not a Realm constraint_subkind. The infrastructure-isolation pattern 'Controlled Collaboration Enclave' is a separate, unchanged concept.
The v1 container model is Space (board / list / etc.) and the security boundary is Realm. 'Place' MUST NOT appear as a core model name in normative prose, SDK identifiers, or UI copy.
List-shaped containers are Spaces, not Realms. Realm remains the boundary concept; container shape (board / list / etc.) lives on Space.

Room is not the v1 core model. Use Realm (federation / identity / replication boundary), Circle (intra-Realm scoped event/message boundary; see zh/models/circle.md), Strand, or Space as applicable. 'Room' is permitted only when contrasting v1 with Matrix in interop documentation.

entries.replacement: Realm history visibility / discoverability / join rule
entries.notes: Visibility is split in v1 into three independent axes: Discoverability, Join Rule, History Visibility (see spec-map 3.4). 'Room visibility' conflates them and MUST NOT be used.

Use plaintext for unencrypted user-readable material. cleartext MUST NOT appear in normative prose, code comments, identifiers, or UI copy except when naming forbidden fields in negative-test contexts.
Arkret v1 canonical event/profile names use ak.; cx. may appear only in negative tests.
Arkret v1 typed IDs use ak:; cx: may appear only in negative tests.
Strand uses track as its display-only segment identifier. Variable and field names MUST NOT contain 'strand_branch'.

entries.replacement: Realm members (or Circle members, when Strand.scope_circle_id points at a Circle)
entries.notes: Track does not carry independent membership; the entire Strand shares one effective scope (Strand.scope_circle_id). UI copy and docs MUST refer to Realm members or Circle members (per zh/models/circle.md). A Strand needing its own membership boundary MUST set scope_circle_id to point at an intra-Realm Circle; per-track membership boundaries do not exist.

Chinese form of 'Controlled Collaboration Realm'; use 'External Collaboration Realm' per zh/models/realm-and-space.md §2.7. The strict sovereign-deployment policy is a deployment-profile requirement on External Collaboration Realm in zh/sync/sovereign-deployment.md §4.
